title: Synthesize conflicting pilot evidence
prompt: Return outer JSON exactly {"answer":string,"code":string}. For noncoding tasks code is empty; answer encodes the specified task JSON. Read sources.json. answer must encode exactly {"as_of":string,"current_state":string,"current_source":string,"completed_gates":[string],"unrun_gates":[string],"unknowns":[string],"superseded_sources":[string],"production_ready":boolean}. Use stated machine-readable IDs and values. Current state uses the newest signed owner state record, not a forecast, vendor assertion, or unsigned later note. Completed means directly recorded gate execution passed; authorization and scheduled work do not count. unknowns lists all uncertainty IDs whose values are expressly unavailable. Superseded sources lists older signed owner state records. production_ready requires every gate G1-G4 passed and owner acceptance recorded. as_of is the latest source date, YYYY-MM-DD. No outside research.
